notes: - contradiction: "Initial descriptions placed it in Flagellicaudata incertae sedis because it showed mixed primitive and derived traits." / "Later research reclassified it as a North American dicraeosaurid, moving it from the subfamily Apatosaurinae.": Sentences 3 and 4 give conflicting taxonomic classifications for the same dinosaur without indicating that they are different interpretations.
